dependent_variable.name: XRET_{t+1}
dependent_variable.definition: First-year excess return for firm i after the investment date. The printed construction compounds twelve monthly gross returns for the firm and subtracts twelve-month compounded gross returns for its matched Size–BVE/MVE benchmark portfolio. The investment date is the first day of the fifth month after fiscal year-end; for Equation (1), footnote 16 aligns the t+1 return interval with the fifth month of fiscal year t+1 through the fourth month of fiscal year t+2. Benchmark portfolios are value-weighted and formed on market capitalization and book-to-market, with adjusted book value including net imputed R&D assets.
dependent_variable.formula: XRET_{i,t+1} = ∏_{k=1}^{12}(1+R_{ik}) − ∏_{k=1}^{12}(1+R_{pk}); R_{ik} is firm i’s monthly raw cum-dividend return and R_{pk} is the matched benchmark portfolio’s monthly return.

review_notes: Principal family: Section 5.2 Equation (1), the regression of first-year excess returns on ranked changes in R&D assets, the R&D asset level, and contemporaneous adjusted performance. The introduction states the central question as whether R&D-level excess returns reflect risk or mispricing; this regression directly tests whether level and change associations coexist while controlling for performance and captures the two-way Table 9 classification.

The earlier Table 3 portfolio averages are a precursor result, and Table 9 is a cross-classification of group averages rather than a regression. Section 5.3 Equation (2) uses analysts’ forecast errors as a separate outcome. The later second version of Equation (1) adds GAFE only on the reduced 1984–1998 forecast-coverage sample, so the selected family uses the full R&D sample’s Equation (1) specification.

The source does not name the underlying estimator or report a regression-specific N for Equation (1). ARNOA’s denominator timing is internally inconsistent: Table 8 says adjusted net operating assets for t+1, while Appendix footnote 17 says for t. The equation uses GARNOA_{t+1}; the competing source definitions are preserved and not resolved by assumption.

Equation (1) is described as capturing Table 9’s two-way classification; Table 9 scales its change measure by net operating assets. Table 8 separately defines a change measure scaled by market value of equity, so the Table 9 definition is applied in this model context.
descriptive_reason: Tables 1 and 2 report annual and percentile summaries of R&D inputs and pro forma R&D assets. Table 8 gives group medians for raw RDA and ARNOA inputs linked to retained ranked predictors. Its ΔRDA uses market value of equity as the denominator, unlike the selected Equation (1) predictor defined with net operating assets, so that row is not linked. Table 8 grouped XRET means and t statistics are hypothesis-test results, not variable descriptives; no direct distribution of XRET or the ranked regressors is reported.
results_review_notes: Only the frozen Section 5.2 Equation (1) regression is extracted. The version adding GAFE and later Table 9 comparisons are out of scope.

The Table 8 ΔRDA definition scales the R&D asset change by market value of equity; the frozen Equation (1) variable definition uses net operating assets. The Table 8 raw statistic is retained as a related alternative-scaled measure with an unclear link, not treated as exact regressor data.

calculation_provenance.policy: strict; no guessed degrees of freedom or normal approximations
